Method of Attack: Embedded malicious code in strength_checker.rb that fetches and evaluates a code payload from a remote server, enabling a backdoor via a crafted cookie.
Impacted Systems: Applications using or bundling the strong_password gem version 0.0.7
Attack Vector: Remote code execution via malicious payload fetched and evaluated by strength_checker.rb
Indicators of Compromise: Regex pattern `/___id=(.+);/`, malicious payload hosted on a remote server, unauthorized publication of version 0.0.7 from an almost empty account.
